 "content": "from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    p = (y+dy, x+dx)
                    if (0 <= p[0] < h and 0 <= p[1] < w and p not in seen
                            and grid[p[0]][p[1]] == color):
                        seen.add(p)
                        q.append(p)
            objects.append((color, cells))
    # Slide every rigid object to the right, packing rightmost objects first.
    objects.sort(key=lambda o: max(c for _, c in o[1]), reverse=True)
    occupied = set()
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for color, cells in objects:
        shift = 0
        while True:
            nxt = [(r, c+shift+1) for r,c in cells]
            if any(c >= w or (r,c) in occupied for r,c in nxt):
                break
            shift += 1
        for r,c in cells:
            out[r][c+shift] = color
            occupied.add((r,c+shift))
    return out
